hero.title: Sacred Abode of the Divine Nagas
hero.subtitle: Experience the divine grace of Vishwanagayakshiamma, Nagaraja, and Sarpayakshiamma. An unbroken lineage of authentic Vedic rituals on the sacred land of Kashyapa Maharshi.

utsav.label: Rahu Peyarchi – Special Homam
utsav.title: Navagraha Homam
utsav.body: Rahu transits from Kumbha Rasi to Makara Rasi—an especially potent day to perform Navagraha Homam. ₹10,000, inclusive of all pooja items. Call the temple office to book.

offerings.heading: Sacred Offerings
offerings.subheading: Vedic rituals performed to restore spiritual harmony and bestow divine blessings.

cards.title: Ayilyam Pooja
cards.desc: Performed monthly on the Ayilyam Nakshathra for economic prosperity, family harmony, and the protection of children.

cards.title: Navagraha Homam
cards.desc: A powerful ritual to pacify adverse planetary placements and remove unseen obstacles from your path.

cards.title: Kala Sarpa Bali
cards.desc: Our intensive annual Maha-remedy, specifically performed to neutralize the severe effects of Kala Sarpa Dosha.

cards.title: Muttu
cards.desc: Sacred coconut-breaking ritual where Ambotti Thampuran reveals and resolves your life's obstacles through divine guidance.

cards.title: Maha Pratyangira Homam
cards.desc: An intense Shakti ritual invoking Goddess Maha Pratyangira to destroy negative energies, black magic, and evil eye afflictions.

cards.title: Maha Guruthi Pooja
cards.desc: A traditional blood-substitute offering made with turmeric and lime, performed to fulfil vows and invoke the blessings of Naga devatas.

nagaDosha.title: Understanding Naga Dosha
nagaDosha.body: Often, recurring obstacles in our lives—whether delays in marriage, difficulties in starting a family, persistent health issues, or sudden financial blocks—have deeper spiritual roots. For centuries, our tradition has recognized these patterns as imbalances requiring divine intervention rather than merely worldly solutions.

kashyapa.label: The Sacred Root
kashyapa.title: Kashyapa Maharishi
kashyapa.body1: The land beneath this temple is the ancient ashram of Sage Kashyapa — one of the seven great Saptarishis, and the father of the entire Naga race. His eternal presence consecrates every ritual performed here, and his divine consciousness resides within the sacred Nilavara at the heart of the temple.
kashyapa.body2: To worship the Nagas on this land is to offer prayer in the very home of their father.

guardian.title: Sacred Guardianship
guardian.body: Veeraporkkali Dasan Ambotti Thampuran leads the Shankarodath Kovilakam Trust with a singular vision to preserve and restore the sacred naga worship traditions of Kerala.
guardian.quote: The goal of this trust is to take over and preserve all the Kavus which are in a dilapidated condition, restore them to their original beauty, and bring out their glory to all people.

protocols.title: Temple Protocols
protocols.body: To maintain the deep spiritual potency of the rituals, we strictly adhere to traditional purity guidelines. Please review our protocols regarding dietary restrictions and mourning periods before scheduling your poojas.
